==Usage==
<pre>{{WookieeProjects|Ambition|Astrography|Battlefront|Comics}}</pre>
creates:
{{WookieeProjects|Ambition|Astrography|Battlefront|Comics}}

The template currently supports up to six separate [[Wookieepedia:WookieeProjects|WookieeProjects]], but more could be added as necessary.
